questions.s:
The error lies in the use of the reciprocal pronoun "each other". Reciprocal pronouns are used to indicate that two or more people are carrying out an action of the same type, with both receiving the benefits or consequences.

"Each other" is used when referring to two people or things. "One another" is used when referring to more than two people or things. Since the sentence refers to "five team members" (more than two), the correct reciprocal pronoun is "one another".

Correct sentence: The five team members constantly argued with one another instead of working towards the goal.

questions.q:
Identify the type of pronoun underlined in the following sentence.

Which is the most beautiful dress?
questions.s:
The correct answer is option 1.

Pronouns are words that replace a noun. 

There are seven types of pronouns-

1. Personal pronoun-  they replace nouns representing people. Eg- he, she, etc.

2. Demonstrative pronoun-  used to demonstrate (or indicate). Eg- this, these, etc.

3. Indefinite pronoun- used for non-specific things. Eg- all, none, etc.

4. Interrogative pronoun-  used in questions. Eg- who, which, etc. 

5. Possessive pronoun-used to show possession. Eg- mine, yours, etc.

6. Reflexive pronoun-  ends ...self or ...selves and refers to another noun or pronoun in the sentence. They always refer to the subject. Eg- yourself, yourselves, etc.

7. Intensive pronoun-refers back to another noun or pronoun in the sentence to emphasize it. They may not refer to the subject. Eg- himself, itself, etc.

questions.s:

  • We know that some verbs are proceeded by reflexive pronoun. These verbs are: 
    • revenge, present, absent, pride, available, avail, acquit, kill, prepare, enjoy, introduce, apply, etc. 
      • Example: She prides herself on doing a good job
  • Therefore, by reading the above explanation we find that the correct answer is 'avail yourself of'. 
    ​

Thus, the correct sentence is: Try to avail yourself of every opportunity that comes your way.

Additional Information

  • If we use an intransitive verb in a sentence then there is no need for a Direct object/ Reflexive Pronoun/ Verbs which we usually do for themselves. Such kind of 'Verbs' is:
    • Complain, Shave, Shower, Keep, Stop, Behave, Pit, Remember, Down, etc.
      • Example: Justin always shaves on Sunday.
